items.title: Merck (MRK) Could Be 7% Undervalued As MASH Trial Data Lifts Optimism
items.summary: Merck (MRK) is back in focus after reporting Phase 2b data showing its investigational GLP-1 and glucagon co-agonist efinopegdutide achieved statistically significant MASH resolution without fibrosis worsening, which has fueled fresh interest in the stock. Against this backdrop of pipeline news, Merck’s share price has moved to $148.05, with a 90-day share price return of 11.38% and a year-to-date share price gain of 39.08%. items.title: Merck Shares Rose Even As Profit Fell
items.summary: If you had bought Merck on 10 November 2025, you might now be replaying that choice. For Merck shareholders, the return over the past year was 67.6%, including dividends. That gain landed after a year when some analysts focused on a growing late stage pipeline and big US manufacturing plans, while others worried about pricing pressure and the coming Keytruda patent expiry.
